popCulture.title: Achaeus (son of Xuthus)
popCulture.description: Son of Xuthus and brother of Ion — eponymous ancestor of the Achaeans in the Hellenic stemma. Not the Seleucid general Achaeus.

popCulture.title: Achaeans (Homer)
popCulture.description: Homer's name for the Greeks at Troy — the ethnic label that later genealogy traces to this Achaeus.

popCulture.title: Achaea (ancient region)
popCulture.description: The northern Peloponnesian region that keeps Achaeus' name in geography — the tribal eponym as place.

popCulture.title: Hellen
popCulture.description: Achaeus' grandfather through Xuthus — the stem from which Dorians, Ionians, and Achaeans branch.
